semiconductor_relevance: High — SCH Electronics (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. provides essential semiconductor equipment and services, including gas supply systems and consumables.
summary: SCH Electronics (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. specializes in lending semiconductor equipment and offering comprehensive services such as gas central supply system installation and wastewater disposition. Established in 2001, the company also supplies consumables and spare parts critical for semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Special gas layout design and installation
Supply of consumables including MFC, Purifier, and quartz components

regional_presence.China: The company is located in the Zhangjiang Hi-tech Park, Shanghai, focusing on the semiconductor sector.
